idx-format.name: IDX format
idx-format.definition: A binary array format with magic, dimension sizes, and a contiguous payload.
idx-format.explanation: MNIST image IDX files begin with magic number 2051, a count, rows, and columns; label files begin with 2049 and a count. Header integers are 32-bit big-endian values. Payload bytes follow in row-major order. A safe reader validates magic, positive dimensions, matching counts, checked size arithmetic, and exact byte length before interpreting data. The format supplies structure, while dataset meaning and split policy come from MNIST documentation.

softmax.name: Softmax
softmax.definition: A function that converts a vector of logits into positive probabilities summing to one.
softmax.explanation: Softmax exponentiates shifted logits and divides each exponential by their sum. Subtracting the maximum logit prevents overflow without changing the ratio. With cross-entropy and a class-index target, the logit gradient is probability minus the one-hot target. Softmax probabilities express competition among the listed classes; they do not guarantee calibrated uncertainty or account for classes absent from the model. Temperature scaling can change confidence while preserving the same basic normalization.
